name: Final Week
source: You play as a guy who is a successful college student, but has trouble finding a girlfriend. It's your final week of college before graduation, and all of a sudden, your luck changes. Which girl will you end up with?
translation: 你将扮演一名成绩优异的大学生，却苦于找不到女朋友。毕业前的最后一周到了，突然之间，你的运气发生了转变。最后你会和哪个女孩在一起？
